title: Jacques Derrida's birth chart
metaDescription: Jacques Derrida's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 22.3° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Cancer — the Sun, Mercury, Jupiter and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 22.3° of Cancer is the Sun's exact seat — third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Cancer (22.4°), Venus in Virgo (0.9°), Mars in Gemini (0.7°): thought steeped in tone and memory, attraction that grows by reliability, effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts the Sun in the same degree of the zodiac from Mercury, 0.1° off exact. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, Venus square Mars at 0.3°, and Venus conjunction Neptune at 0.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks three placements here. Venus in Virgo at 0.9° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Cancer at 4.2° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Saturn in Capricorn at 7.5° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 water, 3 earth, 1 air, 1 fire; by modality, 6 cardinal, 4 mutable. Saturn was retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.9° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 13.4°.
